target: and must NOT be refused: the call is already paid for, and discarding a complete answer over prose length destroys metered work to enforce a style rule
cmd: LONG=$(python3 -c "print(\" \".join([\"word\"]*260))"); jq -n --arg s "$LONG" "{worker:\"placeholder\",status:\"ok\",summary:\$s,result:\"r\",artifacts:[],key_decisions:[],caveats:[],assumptions:[],confidence_ordinal:\"high\",usage:{}}" > env.json; jq -n --arg c "$(jq -c . env.json)" "{choices:[{message:{content:\$c}}],usage:{prompt_tokens:1,completion_tokens:1,cost:0}}" > mock.json; printf %s "{\"objective\":\"x\"}" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE=$PWD/mock.json bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter 2>/dev/null >out; echo "EXIT:$?"; jq -e '.status == "ok"' out >/dev/null && echo ENVELOPE_KEPT
